name: Sheet and View Audit
description: Read-only audit of sheets and views in a saved snapshot: empty sheets, views not on any sheet, duplicate sheet numbers, missing sheet parameters, default view names, and sheet counts per discipline prefix.
author: AEC Model Bridge

snapshot_id.description: Saved snapshot to audit. The snapshot must contain sheet and view data.

required_sheet_parameters.description: Sheet parameters that must be filled in. Defaults to Sheet Number and Sheet Name.
